localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional, unaligned white linear pixel tracks (rake marks) cutting across the dark pigmentation of both lobes.

other_distinctive_markers: Vertical cluster of three small, high-intensity circular markers on the lower right side of the peduncle (viewer right).
